AppellationTitlegainDesc1001.ch:
八荒之内，仅有一位修仙者能拥有永宁第一刀修的道号。
若此道号无人拥有，在所有<r>炼气境、筑基境</r>的$s_dao$资质达到<r>40</r>的修仙者中，实力最强的刀修，可获得永宁第一刀修的道号。
若此道号已被人拥有，修仙者需要找到永宁第一刀修的拥有者，并向其发起道号挑战，挑战成功后可获得永宁第一刀修的道号。
当修仙者灵技和绝技均不是$s_dao$的功法时，则不具备获得或挑战刀修类道号的资格。
AppellationTitlegainDesc1001.en:
Only one Cultivator in the whole world carries the Taoist Title of the Yong Ning No.1 Blade Cultivator.
If the Title is held by no one, then the mightiest Blade Cultivator among all <r>Qi Refining and Foundation Realm</r> Cultivators at <r>40</r> $s_dao$ stats gains the Taoist Title of the Yong Ning No.1 Blade Cultivator.
If the Title has already been taken, then the Cultivator must find whomever the No.1 Blade Cultivator is and challenge them for the Taoist Title. If they succeed in this challenge, the Title will be theirs.
If neither the Spiritual Skill nor the Special Skill of a Cultivator are at Martial Arts $s_dao$, they will not be qualified to either hold the Title or challenge others for it.

If the Title is held by no one, then the mightiest Spear Cultivator among all <r>Qi Condensation and Golden Core Realm</r> Cultivators at <r>120</r> $s_zhang$ stats gains the Taoist Title of the Hua Feng No.1 Palm Cultivator.
If the Title has already been taken, then the Cultivator must find whomever the No.1 Palm Cultivator is and challenge them for the Taoist Title. If they succeed in this challenge, the Title will be theirs.
If neither the Spiritual Skill nor the Special Skill of a Cultivator are at Martial Arts $s_zhang$, they will not be qualified to either hold the Title or challenge others for it.

八荒之内，仅有一位修仙者能拥有华封第一指修的道号。

当修仙者灵技和绝技均不是$s_zhi$的功法时，则不具备获得或挑战指修类道号的资格。

若此道号无人拥有，在所有<r>具灵境、元婴境</r>的$s_feng$资质达到<r>300</r>的修仙者中，实力最强的风修，可获得云陌第一风修的道号。

AppellationTitlegainDesc1210.en:
Only one Cultivator in the whole world carries the Taoist Title of the Yun Mo No.1 Wind Cultivator.
If the Title is held by no one, then the mightiest Wind Cultivator among all <r>Origin Spirit and Nascent Soul Realm</r> Cultivators at <r>300</r> $s_feng$ stats gains the Taoist Title of the Yun Mo No.1 Wind Cultivator.
If the Title has already been taken, then the Cultivator must find whomever the No.1 Wind Cultivator is and challenge them for the Taoist Title. If they succeed in this challenge, the Title will be theirs.
If neither the Spiritual Skill nor the Special Skill of a Cultivator are at Martial Arts $s_feng$, they will not be qualified to either hold the Title or challenge others for it.
